text_block_list.text:
Hearing that Супер Крик is doing some
solo
dance training, I decide to drop by
and watch.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew... That dance session felt amazing!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
But I have to say... Hehe. I liked the way
you were
looking at me...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Your eyes were sparkling like a child's.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list:
I couldn't help myself with how much fun you
seemed to be having.

text_block_list.text:
Goodness, are you getting the urge to
dance too,
Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm glad to hear it! Let's dance
together
next!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
It's okay. We still have some time before
the next
person comes to practice. What
do you say?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: I'd hate to interrupt your practice...

text_block_list.text:
It's okay. We still have some time before
the next
person comes to practice. What
do you say?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик
choice_data_list: I'd hate to interrupt your practice...

text_block_list.text:
It makes me happy to see you this
excited!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I can't believe I get to dance with
you,
Trainer...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Maybe I'll be the one with the sparkling eyes this time! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
But I've been dancing all on my own this
whole
time, and I'm feeling rather
lonely...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Isn't there a kind trainer out there who
could
possibly dance with me?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. Thank goodness, there's one
right
here! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик takes my hand, and we
have fun
dancing together. She appears
to learn something
from watching my
movements.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик beams as we take to the
stage, and
the two of us enjoy our dance
together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
